fichas.title: Passenger lifts for offices, banks, hotels and hospitals
fichas.summary: Lift type and provision depend on building function and expected traffic. Lift installations should be planned for long service life and anticipated increases in demand. The page defines turnaround time, average waiting time and transportation capacity, and illustrates lift shafts, machine rooms, passenger lifts and bed lifts. Tables give structural dimensions and capacities for lift configurations.
